title: genista pilosa subsp. jordanii
intro: Genista pilosa subsp. jordanii, commonly known as Jordan's broom or Jordan's broom shrub, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family, characterized by its small, yellow flowers and slender branches. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Genista pilosa subsp. jordanii include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which can contribute to its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
